topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: The rain's been falling for hours, slapping against the window like it's trying to get in. I’ve been staring at the phone, waiting. Word came in this afternoon, the old lady’s engagement ring turned up in a pawn shop downeast. Couldn't believe it. I knew the old house had its secrets, but this? Was it hers to keep or did someone play a part in this game? The streets are slick with tonight's downpour, the city a blur of soaked faces and hidden motives. I should’ve kept a closer eye, made sure every loose end was tied up tight. Now, there’s only one thing to do—hit the streets, find out who decided it was worth more in a pawn shop than in the family's memory.
